  • Investigate and debug complex issues in customer environments, including multi-control plane scenarios, resource reconciliation problems, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Communicate through thoughtful and thorough design documents for new initiatives and detailed post-incident reviews that drive system improvements.
  • Support the full project lifecycle for highly scalable and reliable services running in a cloud environment – discovery, analysis, architecture, design, review, documentation, building, migration, automation, deployment, production-readiness, and ongoing operational support.
  • Write and maintain Go code that interfaces with the Kubernetes API, such as operators, controllers, add-ons, etc., with a focus on observability, debuggability, and operational excellence.
  • Deploy, manage, and troubleshoot our Kubernetes services in production, using metrics, logs, and traces to identify and resolve issues quickly.
  • Build and maintain operational tooling for debugging customer environments, analyzing control plane health, and automating incident response.
  • Author documentation, user guides, runbooks, and blog posts to support and promote new features that you release.
  • Support the software release cycle for Spaces self-hosted distributions, including diagnosing issues in customer-managed deployments.
  • Participate in on-call rotation to support Upbound Cloud, responding to incidents and driving them to resolution.

What You'll Bring

  • Have experience operating production cloud services at scale: monitoring, alerting, incident response, post-mortems, and continuous improvement of service reliability.
  • Have strong debugging skills across distributed systems, including experience with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing) and techniques for diagnosing issues in production environments.
  • Have experience building and operating controllers that interact with the Kubernetes API server, including troubleshooting reconciliation loops, managing API rate limits, and optimizing controller performance.
  • Are comfortable working directly with customers to understand, reproduce, and resolve complex technical issues in their environments.
  • Take responsibility and ownership for solving problems even if they are outside your lane, especially during incidents affecting customer workloads.
  • Demonstrate excellence in your work, constantly trying to improve your skills and the operational posture of the systems you build.
  • Have empathy for customers and keep them in mind as you build solutions, understanding that reliability and debuggability are features.
  • Realize the importance of clear communication and effective collaboration to work as a team, deliver great results, and support customers through technical challenges.
  • Help create a safe environment where everyone can contribute, learn from failures, share on-call knowledge, and help each other grow as operators and engineers.

If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.

Our team is passionate, empathetic, and committed to improving the lives of our service professionals, our Pros.   • Proficiency in one or more programming languages, with a willingness to learn new ones as needed
  • Experience building and maintaining production systems or applications, including debugging and performance optimization
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, able to work effectively across disciplines and teams
  • A problem-solving mindset with the ability to balance speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
  • Product-oriented thinking, motivated by building solutions that serve real customer needs
  • Curiosity about emerging technologies and enthusiasm for learning and applying them
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to improve workflows, streamline execution, or enhance outputs

  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to improve workflows, streamline execution, or enhance outputs
  • Problem-solving mindset with the ability to balance speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
  • Product-oriented thinking, motivated by building solutions that serve real customer needs
  • Curiosity about emerging technologies and enthusiasm for learning (including a willingness to master Ruby)
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills across disciplines and teams

You’ll join a small and senior squad focused on cross-cutting search concerns, working closely with Product Platform teams, IAM, DevOps, and SRE. We offer support in the learning process, tailored to your needs and any prior experience with Ruby. This may include mentoring from our experienced engineering team or access to a paid online course that you can complete during working hours as part of your onboarding. The exact form of support will be agreed upon based on insights from your selection process.

Sounds interesting?

We're waiting for your resume!

Overview

We are seeking native-level French speakers with a linguistics background to serve as the primary language resource for voice AI in their language. You will be the trusted point of contact for all questions, quality decisions, and language-specific work related to French.

This is not a standard annotation engagement. You will own your language end to end, which includes managing annotation quality, auditing data, monitoring product performance, investigating customer-reported issues, and executing projects that require deep linguistic expertise and attention to detail. You will operate independently across these workstreams and serve as the team's go-to resource for anything related to your language.

This is an ongoing contractor engagement. Availability during some US Pacific business hours is preferred to allow for team syncs and real-time support.

 

About the Engagement

You will coordinate with the Human Evals Manager on project deliverables and timelines. Some examples of what your day-to-day work may include:

  • Answer questions from annotators about guidelines, edge cases, or language-specific issues via an agreed project communication channel.

  • Cascade new feedback, instructions, or rubric updates to annotators working on your projects.

  • Listen to annotator-rated audio files and check whether their ratings and written feedback align with the rubric.

  • Prepare written quality assessments for annotators with specific examples and recommendations.

  • Listen to TTS output and provide ground truth assessments of pronunciation, prosody, and naturalness in your language.

  • Update or expand sections of the annotation guidelines when you find gaps or edge cases.

  • Prep and run calibration meetings with annotators.

  • Hold office hours on a mutually agreed schedule during active studies so annotators can ask questions in real time.

  • Develop onboarding materials and resources for new annotators.

  • Write QA reports on annotation quality and calibration outcomes.

  • Review production audio in your language and flag quality issues to the team.

  • Investigate language-specific issues reported by customers and identify root causes.

  • Audit datasets for linguistic accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

Roughly 40 hours per week with flexibility in scheduling. Project hours may vary depending on active studies, data projects, and product needs. Participation in periodic coordination meetings during US Pacific hours is expected.

 

Requirements

  • Native-level proficiency in French as spoken in France.

  • Experience with data annotation, transcription, or language quality assurance.

  • Strong foundation in linguistics or a related field, with the ability to apply concepts like phonetics, prosody, and intonation when evaluating speech and writing annotation guidelines.

  • Strong written English proficiency. All guidelines, feedback, reports, and team communication are in English.

  • Ability to write clear, structured instructions and deliver specific, actionable feedback to annotators.

  • Comfortable working with data and metrics such as inter-rater agreement scores, audit spreadsheets, and structured feedback templates.

  • Self-directed and able to manage feedback cycles, QA reviews, and data projects without close oversight.

Preferred

  • Experience writing or maintaining annotation guidelines or rubrics.

  • Experience training, mentoring, or managing other annotators.

  • Experience with audio evaluation, TTS, or STT.

  • Conversational spoken English proficiency for meetings and calibration syncs.

  • Experience working with distributed, remote teams.


This is a 1099 contract opportunity and will not be eligible for the benefits below. Language Leads work on an ongoing basis, renewable by mutual agreement. You will control your own methods for completing assigned work, supply your own equipment, and are responsible for your own taxes. You must be authorized to work in your country of residence.

 

Note: Cartesia participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with Form I-9 information to confirm employment eligibility after hire.

🌎 Visa sponsorship: We provide visa sponsorship support and assess each circumstance on a case-by-case basis. However, visa sponsorship is dependent on many factors, including the role you are applying for, and the location you are going to be based, and so we can't always guarantee success. Your Recruiter will work with you to understand your visa sponsorship needs from the first call.

🚢 We ship fast. All of our work is novel and cutting edge, and execution speed is paramount. We have a high bar, and we don’t sacrifice quality or design along the way.

🤝 We support each other. We have an open & inclusive culture that’s focused on giving everyone the resources they need to succeed.

💰 Compensation Competitive base salary alongside attractive equity package.

🩺 Health Insurance Fully covered medical insurance along with dental and vision for you and your family.

🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Parental Leave 9 weeks paternity & 12 weeks maternity leave

🏦 401(k)

🚆 Commuter Allowance A monthly stipend to help you get to and from the office.

🏖️ Flexible PTO Take as much time as you need to recharge your batteries.

🍲 Meals & Snacks Lunch, dinner and plenty of snacks, provided daily.

🦖 Your own personal Yoshi

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Cartesia is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

raw.description:
About Cartesia

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

Overview

We are seeking native-level Japanese speakers with a linguistics background to serve as the primary language resource for voice AI in their language. You will be the trusted point of contact for all questions, quality decisions, and language-specific work related to Japanese.

This is not a standard annotation engagement. You will own your language end to end, which includes managing annotation quality, auditing data, monitoring product performance, investigating customer-reported issues, and executing projects that require deep linguistic expertise and attention to detail. You will operate independently across these workstreams and serve as the team's go-to resource for anything related to your language.

This is an ongoing contractor engagement. Availability during some US Pacific business hours is preferred to allow for team syncs and real-time support.

 

About the Engagement

You will coordinate with the Human Evals Manager on project deliverables and timelines. Some examples of what your day-to-day work may include:

  • Answer questions from annotators about guidelines, edge cases, or language-specific issues via an agreed project communication channel.

  • Cascade new feedback, instructions, or rubric updates to annotators working on your projects.

  • Listen to annotator-rated audio files and check whether their ratings and written feedback align with the rubric.

  • Prepare written quality assessments for annotators with specific examples and recommendations.

  • Listen to TTS output and provide ground truth assessments of pronunciation, prosody, and naturalness in your language.

  • Update or expand sections of the annotation guidelines when you find gaps or edge cases.

  • Prep and run calibration meetings with annotators.

  • Hold office hours on a mutually agreed schedule during active studies so annotators can ask questions in real time.

  • Develop onboarding materials and resources for new annotators.

  • Write QA reports on annotation quality and calibration outcomes.

  • Review production audio in your language and flag quality issues to the team.

  • Investigate language-specific issues reported by customers and identify root causes.

  • Audit datasets for linguistic accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

     

Commitment

Roughly 40 hours per week with flexibility in scheduling. Project hours may vary depending on active studies, data projects, and product needs. Participation in periodic coordination meetings during US Pacific hours is expected.

 

Requirements

  • Native-level proficiency in Japanese as spoken in Japan.

  • Experience with data annotation, transcription, or language quality assurance.

  • Strong foundation in linguistics or a related field, with the ability to apply concepts like phonetics, prosody, and intonation when evaluating speech and writing annotation guidelines.

  • Strong written English proficiency. All guidelines, feedback, reports, and team communication are in English.

  • Ability to write clear, structured instructions and deliver specific, actionable feedback to annotators.

  • Comfortable working with data and metrics such as inter-rater agreement scores, audit spreadsheets, and structured feedback templates.

  • Self-directed and able to manage feedback cycles, QA reviews, and data projects without close oversight.

Preferred

  • Experience writing or maintaining annotation guidelines or rubrics.

  • Experience training, mentoring, or managing other annotators.

  • Experience with audio evaluation, TTS, or STT.

  • Conversational spoken English proficiency for meetings and calibration syncs.

  • Experience working with distributed, remote teams.


This is a 1099 contract opportunity and will not be eligible for the benefits below. Language Leads work on an ongoing basis, renewable by mutual agreement. You will control your own methods for completing assigned work, supply your own equipment, and are responsible for your own taxes. You must be authorized to work in your country of residence.

 

Note: Cartesia participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with Form I-9 information to confirm employment eligibility after hire.

More Details

🏢 In-office policy: We’re an in-person team based out of offices in 🇺🇸 San Francisco, 🇬🇧 London and 🇮🇳 Bangalore. We love being in the office, hanging out together, and learning from each other every day.

🌎 Visa sponsorship: We provide visa sponsorship support and assess each circumstance on a case-by-case basis. However, visa sponsorship is dependent on many factors, including the role you are applying for, and the location you are going to be based, and so we can't always guarantee success. Your Recruiter will work with you to understand your visa sponsorship needs from the first call.

🚢 We ship fast. All of our work is novel and cutting edge, and execution speed is paramount. We have a high bar, and we don’t sacrifice quality or design along the way.

🤝 We support each other. We have an open & inclusive culture that’s focused on giving everyone the resources they need to succeed.

Our Benefits (US Employees Only)

💰 Compensation Competitive base salary alongside attractive equity package.

🩺 Health Insurance Fully covered medical insurance along with dental and vision for you and your family.

🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Parental Leave 9 weeks paternity & 12 weeks maternity leave

🏦 401(k)

🚆 Commuter Allowance A monthly stipend to help you get to and from the office.

🏖️ Flexible PTO Take as much time as you need to recharge your batteries.

🍲 Meals & Snacks Lunch, dinner and plenty of snacks, provided daily.

🦖 Your own personal Yoshi

Notre équipe Commerciale est au cœur de la marketplace de Deliveroo : elle façonne la manière dont nous servons les restaurants, les commerçants et les nouveaux secteurs à travers le monde. De la négociation de partenariats clés au déblocage de nouvelles sources de revenus, en passant par l'élaboration de stratégies de croissance basées sur les données, nous relevons des défis majeurs qui font progresser l'entreprise. Nous recherchons un(e) Employé(e) Polyvalent(e) CDD- 35H pour rejoindre notre équipe à ST Ouen . Dans ce rôle, vous aiderez à maintenir le flux fluide de nos cuisines réservées à la livraison "Editions", en veillant à ce que chaque commande parvienne au client de manière parfaite et dans les délais. Ce que vous ferez Vous rejoindrez l'équipe Editions . Nos sites Editions sont des hubs dédiés exclusivement à la livraison qui permettent aux meilleurs restaurants de se développer dans de nouvelles zones. En tant qu'Agent d'Exploitation, vous êtes le cœur du site, coordonnant les partenaires en cuisine, les livreurs et les clients pour garantir l'excellence opérationnelle. Voici un aperçu de votre quotidien : Gérer le Dispatch : Superviser la remise rapide des plats aux livreurs tout en résolvant proactivement les problèmes en direct entre les cuisines et les partenaires. Garantir la Sécurité Alimentaire : Réaliser les contrôles HACCP et de sécurité quotidiens, en veillant à ce que nos normes élevées d'hygiène alimentaire et de sécurité du site ne soient jamais compromises. Résoudre les Problèmes en Temps Réel : Être le premier point de contact pour les réclamations clients, en utilisant nos processus internes pour garantir un parcours client réussi. Viser l'Excellence du Site : Collaborer étroitement avec le Site Manager et l'Assistant Manager pour atteindre les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et maintenir un service de haute qualité. Piloter le Terrain : Assurer les procédures d'ouverture et de fermeture, en faisant preuve de la polyvalence nécessaire pour assumer tous les rôles sur le site selon les besoins. Ce dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir Essentiel : Forte capacité de polyvalence : Aptitude avérée à gérer des volumes importants d'informations et à jongler avec plusieurs défis opérationnels simultanément. Excellente communication : Compétences claires et efficaces à l'oral comme à l'écrit pour assurer la liaison avec les partenaires et les clients. Esprit d'initiative : Une mentalité proactive avec une capacité démontrée à anticiper les besoins et à agir de manière autonome. Sens de la sécurité : Une solide compréhension (ou une volonté de devenir référent) des normes de sécurité alimentaire et HACCP. Souhaité : Expérience en restauration : Une première expérience opérationnelle dans un environnement de cuisine ou de restaurant. Certifications de sécurité : Formation en premiers secours, sécurité incendie ou sécurité alimentaire (bien qu'une formation puisse être dispensée). Compétences linguistiques : La maîtrise de l'anglais est un plus pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Chez Deliveroo, vous ferez un travail qui compte, en résolvant des problèmes concrets dans une marketplace tripartite en constante évolution. Nous sommes des passionnés de cuisine, des solveurs de problèmes et des créateurs de liens, unis par une volonté commune d'améliorer les choses. En travaillant ici, vous pouvez vous attendre à : 🔧 Avoir un impact visible chaque jour Votre travail améliore directement l'expérience des clients, des partenaires et des livreurs. 🌱 Apprendre vite dans un environnement entrepreneurial Travaillez au plus près du marché avec autonomie, rapidité et de réelles responsabilités. 🧠 Construire une carrière, pas seulement un poste Dépassez-vous, développez de nouvelles compétences et évoluez en même temps que l'entreprise. 🌎 Réussir ensemble dans une culture inclusive Des équipes collaboratives et guidées par des valeurs, qui soutiennent votre façon de travailler. Nous visons à créer un processus équitable qui laisse briller vos compétences — notre parcours de recrutement comprend généralement 3 à 4 étapes. Pour en savoir plus sur notre façon de recruter, cliquez ici . Notre structure mondiale Deliveroo fait désormais partie de DoorDash, réunissant des équipes avec une portée, une échelle et une ambition encore plus grandes. Selon votre rôle, vous pourrez collaborer avec des collègues, des systèmes et des dirigeants à travers DoorDash et Wolt. Ensemble, nous débloquons de nouvelles possibilités en tant qu'équipe mondiale unique. Diversité, Équité et Inclusion Chez Deliveroo, nous savons qu'un lieu de travail exceptionnel reflète le monde qui nous entoure et que la diversité et l'inclusion nous rendent plus forts, plus créatifs et meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons. Si vous aimez les environnements commerciaux dynamiques et que vous souhaitez influencer l'avenir d'une marque mondiale, cette équipe est faite pour vous.

Nous recherchons un(e) Employé(e) Polyvalent(e) CDD- 35H pour rejoindre notre équipe à ST Ouen. Dans ce rôle, vous aiderez à maintenir le flux fluide de nos cuisines réservées à la livraison "Editions", en veillant à ce que chaque commande parvienne au client de manière parfaite et dans les délais.

 

Ce que vous ferez

Vous rejoindrez l'équipe Editions. Nos sites Editions sont des hubs dédiés exclusivement à la livraison qui permettent aux meilleurs restaurants de se développer dans de nouvelles zones. En tant qu'Agent d'Exploitation, vous êtes le cœur du site, coordonnant les partenaires en cuisine, les livreurs et les clients pour garantir l'excellence opérationnelle.

Voici un aperçu de votre quotidien :

  • Gérer le Dispatch : Superviser la remise rapide des plats aux livreurs tout en résolvant proactivement les problèmes en direct entre les cuisines et les partenaires.

  • Garantir la Sécurité Alimentaire : Réaliser les contrôles HACCP et de sécurité quotidiens, en veillant à ce que nos normes élevées d'hygiène alimentaire et de sécurité du site ne soient jamais compromises.

  • Résoudre les Problèmes en Temps Réel : Être le premier point de contact pour les réclamations clients, en utilisant nos processus internes pour garantir un parcours client réussi.

  • Viser l'Excellence du Site : Collaborer étroitement avec le Site Manager et l'Assistant Manager pour atteindre les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et maintenir un service de haute qualité.

  • Piloter le Terrain : Assurer les procédures d'ouverture et de fermeture, en faisant preuve de la polyvalence nécessaire pour assumer tous les rôles sur le site selon les besoins.

Ce dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir

Essentiel :

  • Forte capacité de polyvalence : Aptitude avérée à gérer des volumes importants d'informations et à jongler avec plusieurs défis opérationnels simultanément.

  • Excellente communication : Compétences claires et efficaces à l'oral comme à l'écrit pour assurer la liaison avec les partenaires et les clients.

  • Esprit d'initiative : Une mentalité proactive avec une capacité démontrée à anticiper les besoins et à agir de manière autonome.

  • Sens de la sécurité : Une solide compréhension (ou une volonté de devenir référent) des normes de sécurité alimentaire et HACCP.

Souhaité :

  • Expérience en restauration : Une première expérience opérationnelle dans un environnement de cuisine ou de restaurant.

  • Certifications de sécurité : Formation en premiers secours, sécurité incendie ou sécurité alimentaire (bien qu'une formation puisse être dispensée).

  • Compétences linguistiques : La maîtrise de l'anglais est un plus pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Chez Deliveroo, vous ferez un travail qui compte, en résolvant des problèmes concrets dans une marketplace tripartite en constante évolution. Nous sommes des passionnés de cuisine, des solveurs de problèmes et des créateurs de liens, unis par une volonté commune d'améliorer les choses. En travaillant ici, vous pouvez vous attendre à :

🔧 Avoir un impact visible chaque jour Votre travail améliore directement l'expérience des clients, des partenaires et des livreurs.

🌱 Apprendre vite dans un environnement entrepreneurial Travaillez au plus près du marché avec autonomie, rapidité et de réelles responsabilités.

🧠 Construire une carrière, pas seulement un poste Dépassez-vous, développez de nouvelles compétences et évoluez en même temps que l'entreprise.

🌎 Réussir ensemble dans une culture inclusive Des équipes collaboratives et guidées par des valeurs, qui soutiennent votre façon de travailler.

Notre structure mondiale

Deliveroo fait désormais partie de DoorDash, réunissant des équipes avec une portée, une échelle et une ambition encore plus grandes. Selon votre rôle, vous pourrez collaborer avec des collègues, des systèmes et des dirigeants à travers DoorDash et Wolt. Ensemble, nous débloquons de nouvelles possibilités en tant qu'équipe mondiale unique.

Diversité, Équité et Inclusion

Chez Deliveroo, nous savons qu'un lieu de travail exceptionnel reflète le monde qui nous entoure et que la diversité et l'inclusion nous rendent plus forts, plus créatifs et meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons. title: Senior Social Media Manager - France
description: Why Deliveroo Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it. We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, and looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas. Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it’s a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design, we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand. We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Social Media - France to lead the strategy, planning and delivery of Deliveroo’s French social presence. You’ll shape how Deliveroo shows up across social channels, ensuring our work is culturally relevant, platform-native, creatively ambitious and connected to our wider marketing and business strategy. Sitting within our Global Brand Marketing function and reporting to the Director, Social, Cultural and Earned Media, you’ll work closely with our France Marketing team, agency partners and colleagues across Brand, Media, Integrated Marketing, Consumer Communications, Commercial, Grocery and Retail. This role is open to applicants based in France or England and follows a hybrid working model, with three days a week in either our Paris or London HQ . What You’ll Be Doing You’ll be joining our Social, Culture and Earned Media team, connecting people with Deliveroo through the moments, partnerships and experiences that matter most. You’ll balance strategic ownership with hands-on leadership, setting the long-term direction for social in France while ensuring our day-to-day presence is timely, engaging and effective. Here’s what your day-to-day might look like: Set the direction for social in France , leading our strategy and roadmap across always-on activity, brand campaigns, commercial priorities, cultural moments and reactive opportunities, with a focus on building brand equity, consideration and cultural relevance. Turn global thinking into locally relevant work , translating brand and campaign strategies into social-first ideas, formats and executions that resonate with French audiences and feel native to each platform. Lead our French social presence , overseeing channels including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube, as well as the content calendar, tone of voice and community engagement approach. Bring teams and partners together , acting as the senior social lead for France and collaborating across local Marketing, Brand, Media, Commercial, PR, Global and European Social teams to embed social early in campaign planning and share learnings across markets. Lead creative delivery and partnerships , managing agency partners and influencer activity from briefing and production through approvals and launch, ensuring work meets the right creative, strategic and operational standards. Keep Deliveroo connected to culture , monitoring French culture, creators, communities, trends, platform behaviours and competitors to identify credible opportunities for Deliveroo to join or lead conversations. Turn performance into progress , establishing effective ways of working, reporting on social performance and community insights, and using those learnings to optimise content, campaigns and channel strategy. You’ll also coach junior team members and contribute to raising social standards across markets. What You’ll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others: Deep social and cultural expertise , with strong knowledge of major platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube, alongside an excellent understanding of French culture, internet behaviour, creators, communities and trends. Flawless written French and excellent English communication skills , with the judgement to develop distinctive, accurate and culturally relevant brand communications. Strong strategic and creative judgement , with experience developing social strategies and campaigns that build brand visibility, engagement and cultural relevance, from initial strategy and briefing through execution, optimisation and reporting. A data-informed approach , with a strong understanding of social metrics and the ability to translate performance and community insights into clear recommendations that improve future work. Strong leadership and collaboration skills , with experience managing agency partners, creative development, stakeholders and competing priorities, alongside the ability to coach junior colleagues, influence effectively and operate autonomously in a fast-moving environment. Why Join Us? We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers, proud parents, and more. All energised with an entrepreneurial, relentless spirit which helps us do big things as a team. 🔧 High autonomy to build and deliver impactful work 🌱 Support to learn and grow , from L&D programmes to mentoring 💚 Wellbeing matters , with resources and benefits designed to support our people 🌍 A place to belong , with a global workforce and active employee communities Our benefits differ by country and include support across areas such as healthcare, wellbeing, parental leave, pensions and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Your recruiter can tell you more about the benefits available in your location. The Interview Process We aim to create a fair process that gives you the opportunity to show us your experience, thinking and approach. The process will typically include conversations with our recruitment team and key stakeholders across Brand Marketing, giving you the chance to learn more about the role and team while we explore your social media expertise, strategic thinking, creative judgement, leadership and collaboration style. The role

As a Senior Medical Writer, you'll help develop high-quality scientific content across a broad range of oncology publication activities. You'll work with our teams, authors, and clients to ensure that all materials are scientifically rigorous, engaging, accurate, and delivered to a high standard.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced medical writer who enjoys working with complex scientific data and wants to develop their career within a medical communications environment.

  • Develop and deliver multiple oncology publications, including manuscripts, abstracts, posters, presentations, and congress materials.

  • Review and critically appraise scientific literature and clinical data.

  • Participate in client meetings and presentations, where appropriate.
  • Provide scientific input and guidance to more junior members of the writing team..

About you

You'll be an experienced medical writer with a scientific background and a genuine interest in oncology.

We're particularly looking for someone who has:

  • Several years' experience in medical communications, within an agency environment.
  • Experience developing scientific publications across oncology.
  • A degree or higher qualification in a relevant scientific, medical, or life sciences discipline.
  • A strong understanding of the publication process and relevant industry guidelines.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to scientific accuracy.

Why join ApotheCom?

You'll join a team where scientific expertise, creativity, and collaboration come together to produce communications that genuinely matter.

We offer the opportunity to:

  • Work on high-profile oncology programmes with leading pharmaceutical and biotech clients.
  • Develop your expertise across a diverse and scientifically challenging publication portfolio.
  • Work alongside experienced medical writers, strategists, account managers, and creatives.
  • Take ownership of projects and build strong client and author relationships.
  • Develop your career through ongoing learning, mentorship, and opportunities for progression.

Excellent benefits package including pension and private medical.

Office-based, hybrid or UK remote working available

 

Join ApotheCom and help turn complex science into communications that make a difference.

description:
Please Note: B Lab is not working with a third party to fill this role an no part of our process requires applicants to pay fees. Applicants should only use our job board to submit an application, and will interact directly with our team during this process.

This is a Full-Time Role (40 hours per week, 5 days per week) with no option for part-time work. While this is a remote-first opportunity, the candidate filling this role must be a resident of the Netherlands, the U.K. or Brazil at the start of employment. Additionally, they must be within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam, London, or São Paulo. 
Please visit our Careers page to review all opportunities and submit your application for the role(s) that best fit your location and work authorization.

About the Role

The Data & AI team is responsible for building B Lab's data platform, delivering on business priorities, and scaling AI adoption across the organization. The team reports directly to the CTDO. The Data & ML Platforms team owns the data platform, ML infrastructure, and the foundational data models the rest of the Data & AI team depends on — the supply-side capability layer that Business & Data Priorities and AI Enablement build on. 

As the Data Governance Lead on the Data & ML Platforms pillar, you own data standards, definitions, and sensitivity classification across B Lab's data platform, and ensure the platform and its analytics comply with relevant laws and documentation requirements. Beyond governance, you play a growing role in building data literacy across the organization — helping teams understand and trust the data available to them, and ensuring definitions and standards are actually adopted, not just documented. You work closely with the Senior Analytics Engineer and Data Engineer to make sure new models and pipelines are built to standard from the start.

Core Responsibilities 

Data Standards & Governance (35%):

  • Own Data Standards & Definitions: Establish and maintain the organization's data standards, definitions, and sensitivity classifications.
  • Ensure Compliance: Keep the data platform and analytics practices compliant with relevant laws and internal policy.

Data Literacy & Adoption (30%):

  • Drive Standards Adoption: Work across pillars to ensure data standards are actually used, not just documented.
  • Build Data Literacy: Develop training, documentation, and other enablement so teams across B Lab can confidently interpret and trust the data available to them.

Cross-Pillar Partnership (25%):

  • Partner with Platform Peers: Work with the Senior Analytics Engineer and Data Engineer to ensure new models and pipelines are built to standard.
  • Support Pillar 2 & 3: Help Network Priorities, Regional Enablement, and AI Enablement apply data standards consistently in their work.

Strategic Innovation & Business Impact (10%):

  • Evaluate Governance Tooling: Explore and pilot new tools or approaches for data cataloging, lineage, and standards enforcement.
  • Quantify Literacy Impact: Track and articulate how improved data literacy and standards adoption reduce rework and improve decision quality across teams. 

Major Objectives/Project for the role in the first 6-12 months
  • Create concepts for data classification (public, private, sensitive, etc)
  • Apply concepts to our data 
  • Enable network to understand concepts and how to interact with them
  • Enable the Data Platform to be more aligned with regulatory requirements and laws 

About You

  • Overall 3+ years of experience in data modeling and/or data governance roles
  • SQL/Data Fluency: Working knowledge of SQL and data models sufficient to audit and advise on governance implementation.
  • Data Governance: Experience establishing and maintaining data standards, definitions, and sensitivity/classification frameworks.
  • Data Literacy & Enablement: Experience communicating technical data concepts to non-technical stakeholders and driving adoption of standards across teams.
  • Compliance Knowledge: Familiarity with data-related legal and regulatory requirements relevant to the organization's data platform and analytics.
  • Documentation: Strong written communication skills; comfort building and maintaining clear, discoverable documentation.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Ability to influence without direct authority across the Data & AI department.
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort with facilitating live and asynchronous trainings or workshops on data governance
  • A BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred
  • Fluent in English

 

Compensation Details

B Lab has a compensation plan that includes:

  • A yearly salary in the range of R$212,960 - R$261,030 (not including the 13th salary)
  • Sick & other leave in accordance with Brazilian statutory leave allowance
  • Company provided laptop

We also offer other benefits that are based on company policy and are not included in your contract and therefore are subject to change or addition as our organization works to support our staff.

  • Paid time off during organization-wide closures for wellness
  • Professional Development and time off: 40 hours paid time off with access to professional development after 1 year of service
  • Paid time off for volunteering - after one year of service
  • One time home office set-up allowance
  • Additional perks you may qualify for: monthly home office allowance, monthly food allowance & monthly health insurance reimbursement
  • Remote-first workplace

This will be a CLT contract. This is a Full-Time Role (40 hours per week, 5DWW) with no option for part-time work. 

This job ad is for São Paulo, Brazil. While this is a remote-first opportunity, the candidate filling this role must hold Brazilian work authorization without any time limitations or any other restrictions, and they must be a resident of Brazil at the start of employment. Additionally, they must be within commuting distance of São Paulo. If you wish to be based in one of our other locations listed for this role, please visit our Careers page and submit your application through the job ad that best fits with where you hold residency and work authorization.

 

Hiring Process

We require all of the following in order to consider your application:

  • Resume - Please submit an English translation of your resume
  • Complete responses to our standard set of application questions - Please respond to our questions in English

Please do not include a cover letter. Please note that incomplete applications will not be considered. 

If you progress through additional stages in the hiring process you can expect to:

  • Step 1: Submit your resume and responses to our application questions in full 
  • Step 2: Participate in an interview with a panel via Google Meet or Zoom (all candidates must have their cameras on)
  • Step 3: Participate in an interview with a panel via Google Meet or Zoom (all candidates must have their cameras on)
  • Step 4: Complete an exercise and participate in a final interview with a panel via Google Meet or Zoom (all candidates must have their cameras on)

Please note that your first day of work must be in-person at one of our office locations to complete onboarding documents and meet with some members of our team. 

 

We will begin reviewing applications on September 7th, 2026  and will continue until we identify a diverse and qualified candidate pool.

About B Lab
B Lab™ is the nonprofit behind Certified B Corporations™, a community of businesses that meet verified social, environmental, and governance standards. Together, our movement is working towards a more inclusive, equitable, and fair economic system.

Our history
B Lab began in 2006 with the idea that a different kind of economy was not only possible — it was necessary. Our founders Andrew Kassoy, Bart Houlahan, and Jay Coen Gilbert believed there was a better way to do business: better for workers, better for communities, and better for the planet. When our movement’s first 81 Founding B Corps signed the Declaration of Interdependence in 2007, they were not just proposing a better way of doing business. They were proposing a different definition altogether. 

What we’ve achieved 
B Lab became known for certifying B Corporations™, companies that meet verified standards of social and environmental performance, accountability, and transparency. But we do much more than that. We help mobilize a global community of businesses committed to collective action on society’s most critical challenges. In 2010, B Lab was part of successfully drafting and passing benefit corporation in Maryland, the first U.S. state to do so. This created a legal framework that allows companies to keep their values of care and community, not just shareholder value, at the forefront. Today, benefit corporation legislation is active in 52 jurisdictions around the world. 

Our future
In 2024, leaders from across the network agreed to evolve into a more integrated organization that embodies interdependence. This next iteration of our global network will balance global coherence with local agency to achieve our vision of economic systems change. We are now building this future together.

About the Role

The Data & AI team is responsible for building B Lab's data platform, delivering on business priorities, and scaling AI adoption across the organization. The team reports directly to the CTDO. The Data & ML Platforms team owns the data platform, ML infrastructure, and the foundational data models the rest of the Data & AI team depends on — the supply-side capability layer that Business & Data Priorities and AI Enablement build on. 

As the Data Governance Lead on the Data & ML Platforms pillar, you own data standards, definitions, and sensitivity classification across B Lab's data platform, and ensure the platform and its analytics comply with relevant laws and documentation requirements. Beyond governance, you play a growing role in building data literacy across the organization — helping teams understand and trust the data available to them, and ensuring definitions and standards are actually adopted, not just documented. You work closely with the Senior Analytics Engineer and Data Engineer to make sure new models and pipelines are built to standard from the start.

Core Responsibilities 

Data Standards & Governance (35%):

  • Own Data Standards & Definitions: Establish and maintain the organization's data standards, definitions, and sensitivity classifications.
  • Ensure Compliance: Keep the data platform and analytics practices compliant with relevant laws and internal policy.

Data Literacy & Adoption (30%):

  • Drive Standards Adoption: Work across pillars to ensure data standards are actually used, not just documented.
  • Build Data Literacy: Develop training, documentation, and other enablement so teams across B Lab can confidently interpret and trust the data available to them.

Cross-Pillar Partnership (25%):

  • Partner with Platform Peers: Work with the Senior Analytics Engineer and Data Engineer to ensure new models and pipelines are built to standard.
  • Support Pillar 2 & 3: Help Network Priorities, Regional Enablement, and AI Enablement apply data standards consistently in their work.

Strategic Innovation & Business Impact (10%):

  • Evaluate Governance Tooling: Explore and pilot new tools or approaches for data cataloging, lineage, and standards enforcement.
  • Quantify Literacy Impact: Track and articulate how improved data literacy and standards adoption reduce rework and improve decision quality across teams. 

Major Objectives/Project for the role in the first 6-12 months
  • Create concepts for data classification (public, private, sensitive, etc)

  • Enable the Data Platform to be more aligned with regulatory requirements and laws

  • Documentation: Strong written communication skills; comfort building and maintaining clear, discoverable documentation.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Ability to influence without direct authority across the Data & AI department.
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort with facilitating live and asynchronous trainings or workshops on data governance
  • A BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred
  • Fluent in English

 

Compensation Details

B Lab has a compensation plan that includes:

  • An annual salary in the range of €51,000.00 - €61,000.00 (inclusive of holiday allowance) based on experience and skills
  • 20 vacation days per year, prorated to your start date - front-loaded and restarting each January 1; increased to 25 days after third anniversary

The role has two halves and both carry equal weight. You'll own regional financial control and compliance: the integrity of the balance sheet, the accuracy of management reporting and forecasts, cash, strong local controls, and statutory obligations across Companies House, HMRC and VAT, directed through external advisers. You'll also be a hands-on business partner to UK and Europe leadership, Sales and Customer Success, owning the P&L narrative, bringing a commercial view to pricing, deal terms and customer economics, and making sure teams see the financial consequence of the choices they make. You'll report to the Group Financial Controller with a dotted line to FP&A.

What you'll do

Financial reporting and month-end close

  • Own the integrity of the UK&Europe balance sheet, with reconciliations that stay current, reviewed and explainable

  • Own the accuracy of the UK&Europe monthly group reporting and management accounts with variance commentary that explains movements

  • Be the single point of contact for group finance on anything UK&Europe: queries, adjustments, restatements, consolidation-level questions

Compliance and risk oversight

  • Own the UK&Europe compliance calendar (Companies House, HMRC, VAT) by directing external accountants and advisers

  • Own the adviser relationships (accounting, tax, audit), keeping work well scoped, reviewed and connected back to Heidi's internal finance standards

  • Build an early-warning process so compliance risk is caught and escalated well before it threatens trading status

  • Be the accountable owner if something in the compliance chain breaks down

Commercial business partnering

  • Be the day-to-day finance partner to UK&Europe leadership, owning the regional P&L narrative, budget vs actual and the "why" behind the numbers

  • Bring a commercial lens to pricing, deal terms and customer economics, flagging risk and opportunity early

  • Translate regional performance into clear, decision-ready input for FP&A and company leadership

  • Give UK&Europe business leaders a reliable, self-serve view of their numbers, so decisions stop waiting on Australian hours

  • Feed central finance the regional inputs it needs at close: accrual estimates, revenue and spend context, then review and sign off on the UK&Europe result

Revenue risk and collections

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to resolve aged and disputed balances and unblock stuck revenue

  • Own the commercial view of collection risk: which accounts, why, and what it means for cash, and feed it into forecasting

  • Drive down UK&Europe DSO by fixing the upstream causes (contracting, disputes, process), not by chasing invoices

FinOps, controls and performance frameworks

  • Build the operating rhythm that turns UK&Europe finance from reactive support into a reliable performance framework: clear KPIs, owners, review cadences and escalation paths

  • Partner with budget owners on spend decisions before they are made, rather than policing them after the fact

  • Strengthen financial controls across spend, approvals, vendor onboarding, card usage, subscriptions and commercial commitments, while keeping the process pragmatic for a fast-moving region

  • Review regional AP and card activity, including prompt removal of leaver access and cards, and escalate anomalies to central finance operations

  • Partner with external accountants, tax advisers, compliance providers and other vendors, making sure work is well-scoped, reviewed and connected back to Heidi’s internal finance standards

  • Use FinOps-style discipline to connect spend, usage and outcomes, especially across tooling, GTM systems, implementation costs and region-specific operating expenses

  • Create simple documentation and control checks so the region can scale without relying on informal knowledge or one-off fixes

What you'll need

  • Strong commercial and financial acumen — comfortable moving between P&L narrative, deal economics and cash impact

  • Experience business partnering with Sales, Customer Success or regional leadership in a growth business

  • Track record improving collections or DSO by fixing root causes, not just process

  • Experience owning spend or expense controls in a way that supports the business rather than only governing it

  • Comfortable directing (not necessarily performing) statutory compliance and VAT work through external advisers

  • High degree of autonomy and ownership in a small, remote-first global finance team

  • Clear, confident communicator — able to hold your own with commercial leaders and external advisers alike

  • Experience in a multi-entity or multi-currency business

Nice to have

  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company

  • Qualified accountant (ACA / ACCA / CIMA or equivalent)

  • Exposure to Companies House, HMRC and Irish Revenue processes

  • Experience with Campfire, Airwallex or similar modern finance tooling

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You'll join a team focused on real-world impact over imaginary valuations and glossy PR. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we'd like to see. We're medicos, engineers, builders, and designers who've felt the moral and practical toll of what non-care feels like. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. Building what we're building isn't always easy. But we didn't choose easy, we chose to build something that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognise that the deeper question isn't whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. Description

  • Implement Temporal workflow activities in Go: HSS adapter, PCRF adapter, Inventory update.
  • Build and validate unit tests for all workflow activities from day one.
  • Build the Inventory Management Database: tables, indexes, partitioning for 30M records.
  • Build bulk import tooling: CSV → ICCID/IMSI/MSISDN range ingestion from vendor.
  • Implement REST API endpoints for Inventory DB (allocate, reserve, release, query SIM records).
  • Write integration tests: workflow → mock NE → database assertions.
  • Support Sr. Developer on all workflow development tasks — pair programming expected.
  • End-to-end test suite: full provisioning flow from SIM activation to order closed.
  • Load and stress testing: simulate peak TPS provisioning against all systems.
  • Test automation: CI pipeline integration for all workflow and API tests.
  • HSS sync integration: IMSI allocation state reflected in HSS (mock → real NE).
  • MNP (number portability) hooks in Inventory DB.
  • UAT support: reproduce bugs, write regression tests, validate fixes.

Requirements

Must Have

  • 2–4 years backend software development in production environments.
  • Go or Java — primary development language for this role is Go.
  • Java accepted if strong fundamentals and willing to work in Go (we will support the transition).
  • REST API development — building APIs consumed by other services and tested by automated suites.
  • PostgreSQL — table design, indexes, writing queries, understanding query plans .
  • Unit and integration testing — writing tests is a first-class responsibility, not an afterthought.
  • Git — branching, pull requests, code review participation.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures using RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Redis Pub/Sub.
  • Basic Kubernetes knowledge — understanding how your workloads are deployed.
  • Ability to work under technical direction of a senior lead and execute quickly.
  • Fluent English.

Strong Advantage

  • * Any workflow engine experience: Temporal, Camunda, Apache Airflow, AWS Step Functions.
  • * Telecom or BSS/OSS background — understanding of SIM lifecycle, provisioning, activation.
  • * Test framework experience: Go testing, Testify, mock frameworks.
  • * Load testing tools: k6, Locust, JMeter — running and interpreting results.
  • * Docker — building and running containerised services.
  • * Experience with event-sourced or append-only database patterns.

Nice to Have

  • Temporal.io SDK experience — even personal/side project counts.
  • Python — useful for scripting, test tooling, data processing.
  • Prometheus — understanding how to instrument code with metrics.
  • Telecom protocol familiarity: Diameter, SS7, SMPP.

Founded in early 2010, Webbing is a global data MVNO that delivers enterprise grade, global connectivity and IoT services across more than 200 countries and 600+ mobile carriers' networks. Webbing's secured network delivers network protection and web content intelligence.

Enterprise customers can manage, monitor, and optimize data usage in real-time with Webbing's powerful software platform. Gain visibility by application type and have the power to white list applications and limit non-business applications with the click of a button, saving money and improving compliance.

  • An exciting and challenging greenfield platform with great skill and knowledge development opportunities.
  • The opportunity to join a team of highly professional specialists in an international environment.
  • The opportunity for professional development within a reputable international innovative and growing company.

description: At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world. In these markets, we are driving growth and innovation with an industry-leading product portfolio and global manufacturing capabilities. TE /448GB/shas specialized in socket products since 1970 and has developed a large size socket (>10K pin count), small pitch socket (<0.4mm pitch) for high-speed applications (224/448Gbps) ROLE OBJECTIVE As Principal R&D Product Development Engineer of the DDN socket team, you will focus on creating relationships with customer innovators and influencers, defining and driving technical activities, coordinating and facilitating technical engineering-related communications for internal/external customers, creating the product standard for a key technology, and contributing to the technical roadmap of the socket products. Job Requirements 1. Concept Development & Design • Develop innovative design concepts and conduct feasibility studies to assess technical and commercial viability. • Collaborate with global Product Design Engineering (PDE) teams to accurately convert VOC and PRD into detailed design inputs for precise socket development. • Create simplified 3D models and perform signal integrity (SI) simulations using advanced tools such as Ansys HFSS to validate electrical signal performance. • Build and test prototype samples, execute design validation plans, and complete product qualification to finalize specifications. 2. Strategic & Leadership Responsibilities • Lead end-to-end product development of high-speed, fine-pitch, large-size sockets—from market definition, concept creation to design, review, and production release. • Foster strong alignment between business and customer engineering teams to deepen market understanding and drive customer-centric innovation. • Responsible for mentoring and training engineering teams in advanced mechanical design principles and signal integrity simulation methodologies, including hands-on guidance in using industry-standard tools such as Creo and Ansys HFSS, to ensure design robustness, performance optimization, and alignment with high-speed interconnect requirements. 3. Customer & Market Engagement • Collaborate closely with customers and internal stakeholders (Sales, System Architects, FAEs, and PMs) to capture clear Voice of Customer (VOC) and translate it into conceptual designs and preliminary product specifications. • Engage in early-stage pathfinding with customers to co-develop cutting-edge interconnect solutions that meet future technological needs. • Prepare and present engineering evaluations and proposals to customers, aligning solutions with application requirements and performance targets 4. Manufacturing Support & Quality Assurance • Provide technical support to manufacturing and quality teams to ensure efficient ramp-up, process optimization, and safe product launches. • Support cross-functional teams—including customers, Sales, PMs, and manufacturing sites—through DFMEA, testing, troubleshooting, and engineering analysis. Competencies SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers)

The work

iMerit, an EXL company, is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing.

Much of the job comes down to this: look at the image, look at what the model said about it, and decide whether the two actually match.

What you will do

  • Review images alongside the prompts and responses attached to them

  • Interpret both visual and conversational context before scoring anything

  • Compare multiple responses and rank them against defined criteria

  • Confirm that descriptions and claims about an image reflect what is actually there

  • Verify factual claims using approved research sources

  • Flag tasks that cannot be reliably evaluated

  • Write clear justification for every ranking you submit

What you bring

  • A sharp eye for visual detail and the patience to look twice

  • Strong critical thinking, research skills, and reading comprehension

  • Sound judgment and well supported decision making

  • Professional written English, including the ability to describe what you see precisely

  • The consistency to apply detailed guidelines the same way, task after task

  • Experience in image annotation, content review, editing, research, design, or localization is welcome but not essential.

Good to know

  • Independent contractor engagement for the length of the project.Â 

  • Fully remote with flexible scheduling around agreed deadlines.

  • Tasks include visual content, so a device and connection that display images comfortably are required.

  • Volume varies with project demand.

title: General Manager - New Product
description: Who We Are: At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love. Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £150 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work. And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale. 🔑 The opportunity Omaze is building a new consumer proposition for the UK market to take our prize draws and charitable impact to a whole new level. We're looking for a General Manager to take end-to-end ownership of the proposition — from launch through to scale. This is a true business-owner role. You'll own the P&L, strategy and performance of the proposition, bringing together Product, Marketing, Commercial, Finance, Legal, Operations, Analytics and other teams around a single set of outcomes. Your job is to create clarity about what needs to happen, make the right commercial, customer and partner decisions, and ensure the organisation delivers against them with pace and a high bar for quality. Initially, you'll take an emerging business model and turn it into something customers love and Omaze can operate successfully at scale. You'll work through the commercial, operational and customer complexities of launching something new, establish its economics and operating model, and build a roadmap for growth. As the proposition develops, you'll be accountable for making it better every cycle: improving the customer experience, strengthening the economics, resolving operational friction, identifying growth opportunities and ensuring we learn quickly. This is a rare role for someone who combines commercial judgement, product thinking, operational rigour and a strong bias towards action . 🔧 What You’ll Be Doing Own the business Own the strategy, P&L and overall performance of the proposition. Develop a deep understanding of the economic drivers of the proposition and identify the highest-leverage opportunities to improve growth and profitability. Set clear goals and KPIs and establish the weekly, monthly and quarterly operating rhythm required to manage the business. Partner with finance to build and maintain the financial model, forecasts and operating plan for the business. Make clear recommendations about investment, prioritisation and trade-offs. Identify emerging risks and opportunities early and ensure the organisation acts on them . Build and evolve the proposition Own the end-to-end customer proposition and ensure we are solving a compelling customer problem. Partner with Marketing to develop the go-to-market and customer growth strategy for the proposition. Set the direction and priorities for the product roadmap in partnership with Product, Design and Engineering. Maintain a high bar for the quality, simplicity and usability of the customer experience. Ensure we ship quickly, learn from real customer behaviour and continually improve the proposition. Combine customer insight, commercial performance and experimentation to determine what we build next. Balance short-term delivery with the longer-term capabilities required to scale. Lead across Omaze Act as the single point of accountability for the proposition across the organisation. Bring together teams across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Creative, Commercial, Operations, Legal, Finance and Analytics. Create clarity around priorities, decisions, ownership and deadlines. Resolve cross-functional blockers quickly and escalate where necessary. Build trust with senior leaders by providing a clear, data-driven view of performance, risks and opportunities. 🤩 About You This isn't a conventional functional leadership position. We're looking for someone who has previously operated as a business owner . You'll probably have: Significant experience owning and growing a consumer business, product line, category, market or marketplace. Meaningful P&L ownership and strong financial and commercial fluency. Experience launching or materially scaling a new product, proposition, category or business model. Strong understanding of product development and the ability to make excellent product decisions without necessarily having spent your career in Product. Experience working through complex commercial arrangements, partnerships or negotiations. Strong operational instincts and experience turning complex or manual processes into scalable operating models. Strong analytical skills and the ability to understand the few inputs that really drive a business. Experience leading multidisciplinary teams, including through influence rather than reporting lines. A track record of operating effectively in ambiguity and making decisions with imperfect information. Extremely high standards for customer experience and execution. The ability to move comfortably between long-term strategy and detailed operational problem-solving. 🙌 What’s In It For You Generous stock options scheme 25 days annual leave PLUS Bank Holidays Private medical and dental insurance 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2% A generous personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships Enhanced family leave policies Life assurance of 4x your salary DEI Statement We actively seek out diversity of thought and experience to drive innovation. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and perspectives and work hard to ensure that every Omaze employee can bring their authentic self to work at all times. raw.title: Director of Go-to-Market Engineering
raw.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.


About the Role

We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering.

Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it.

You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations, lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.

This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace.

The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.

What You'll Do

Own the strategy and the stack

  • Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.

  • Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.

  • Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.

  • Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on

  • Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.

  • Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.

  • Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.

  • Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM

  • Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.

  • Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.

  • Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.

  • Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical

  • Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.

  • Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.

  • Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team

  • Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.

  • Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.

  • Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

What Will Make You Successful

Experience

  • Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS

  • Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team

  • Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft

  • Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.

  • Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.

  • Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.

  • Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly.

Commercial instinct

  • You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

  • You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.

  • You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have

  • Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.

  • Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.

  • Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.

Why This Role

GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast.

You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible.

If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.
